In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of high resolution silicon microstrip detectors with a large active area and low material budget for use in the vertex detectors of high luminosity experiments at the SSC.
the development of high spatial resolution silicon detectors for use in the vertexing system at a future e + e − collider.
the design and construction of a new generation of high resolution microstrip silicon detectors for high-energy physics.
